preparer: Session F source and authority worker
whatThisDocumentIs: A per-route adjudication of what the adopted Kansas permission does and does not reinstate. The licence exclusion that closed six Kansas routes has been superseded by an attested grant covering nine named Judicial Council documents. This record decides, route by route, whether that route is reinstated, which of the nine it needs, what output strategy it takes, and what still holds it. It implements nothing, creates no receipt, binds no source and marks no track ready.

supersedingPermission.evidenceBasis: project-owner attestation; the hard copy is retained by the project owner and is not bound by hash in the repository. The project owner determined the attestation is controlling. This record does not reopen that.

supersededExclusion.notRewritten: The exclusion was correct when it was made and is left exactly as written. What changed is the fact it rested on, not its reasoning.

currentnessOwner.headline: All seven retained documents print exactly the revision the repository records for them. Currentness against the Council's own current publication is undetermined for all nine, because www.kjc.ks.gov returns HTTP 403 to automation behind Akamai and the Judicial Branch self-help channel is separately behind a Cloudflare 403.

reinstatementStandard.statement: Reinstatement is per route and is not automatic. The exclusion was terminal and correct; the fact it rested on has changed. A route is reinstated only in respect of the gate the licence actually closed, and remains held by any identity, currentness, role, scope or legal-design gate the licence never touched.
reinstatementStandard.whatTheGrantDoes: It removes the commercial-reproduction gate from nine named documents. Nothing else.
whatTheGrantDoesNot: supply bytes for a document the corpus does not hold under a bound identity
resolve the identity of a document outside the nine
authorize completing a field the governing form assigns to a court, clerk, prosecutor, law-enforcement agency or other outside party
answer a venue, docketing, fee or packet-composition question
reinstatementStandard.headlineResult: The licence gate is lifted on all six routes and on all nine covered documents. No route becomes buildable. Every one of the six is still held by at least one gate the licence never reached, and the holder differs by route.

permissionScope.scopeIsAList: The grant scopes by naming the nine, not by naming a family. A document nobody has considered cannot be swept in by category, and anything off this list falls through to the open jurisdiction-level question and stays fail-closed.
boundariesThatSurviveReinstatement: changing official legal text, titles, numbers or revision marks
applying this permission to forms issued by another publisher
permissionScope.prefillMeaning: Deterministic case information means facts already fixed by the participant's own record — case number, county, court, charge, disposition date. It does not extend to a finding, an order, a hearing date the court has not set, or a fact about service that has not happened.

firstHandEvidenceEstablishedByThisJob.why: Two of the nine were recorded as held by no adopted edition, and the criminal cover sheet's revision was recorded as uncorroborated. Both statements were true of the sources those records could read. The repository's own artifact registry points at retained binaries that neither record measured, and this job measured them.
firstHandEvidenceEstablishedByThisJob.method: Bytes read and hashed at first hand from the paths the source-artifact registry records; page faces and footers read page by page with pdftotext; AcroForm structure measured with scripts/rcap-factory-inspect-pdf.mjs. No perimeter was probed, no request was sent to any Kansas publisher, no binary was copied, materialized, committed or receipted.

corpusFindingThatChangesTheRemedy.whatChanges: The gap is not an acquisition gap. It is an edition and identity-binding gap. The bytes exist, they are measured, and their printed faces match the recorded identity. confirmedProjectionDefect.statement: The nine covered Kansas identities are still dispositioned deliberately_excluded_commercial_license in the official-PDF source assignment projection, and that is a code defect rather than a licence fact.
confirmedProjectionDefect.verifiedHow: The supersession-aware authorization index was built from the integrated corpus at this base commit and asked for each of the nine by documentId. It resolves the Kansas decision to rcap-ks-project-owner-permission-authorization, verdict 'authorized', supersedes rcap-ks-commercial-license, scoped to nine documents, and returns 'authorized' for all nine.

whereTheDefectIs.construction: excludedKansasIds is built unconditionally from rcap-ks-commercial-license.json's excludedDocuments list, with no supersession check.
whereTheDefectIs.branch: officialPdfDisposition() returns deliberately_excluded_commercial_license for any KS document in that set, and that branch is evaluated before the supersession-aware licenseDeniedJurisdictions check that immediately follows it.
whereTheDefectIs.consequence: A superseded refusal outranks the grant that superseded it, for Kansas only, and only because Kansas is the one jurisdiction with a hard-coded per-document exclusion set.

confirmedProjectionDefect.sameDefectClass: This is the shape the Colorado JDF-2371 gate had — a licence written into a hard-coded branch, so the gate stayed shut when the grant landed — and the shape the jurisdiction-level gate had for Indiana before the supersession fix at this base commit. Kansas was left behind because its exclusion is per-document rather than per-jurisdiction.
confirmedProjectionDefect.correctionRequired: Resolve the Kansas per-document exclusion through buildSourceAuthorizationIndex/authorizationFor, as licenseDeniedJurisdictionSet already does, so a superseding grant is honoured for the documents it names and the exclusion continues to apply to every document it does not. Fail-closed behaviour must be unchanged: a Kansas document outside the nine still resolves non-permitting.
confirmedProjectionDefect.correctionOwner: the factory/platform owner. This is a shared-library path and is outside this job's owned paths; it is stated here and deliberately not applied.
confirmedProjectionDefect.doNotApplyByHand: The projection is generated. It must not be edited to show the reinstatement; it must be regenerated after the resolver is corrected.

labellingHazardToCheckAtTheSameTime.observation: Four of the nine projection rows carry an officialDocument value with the revision suffix stripped — KSJC-PETITION-EXPUNGEMENT-ARREST-RECORD, KSJC-ORDER-EXPUNGEMENT-ARREST-RECORD-COVER-SHEET, KSJC-PETITION-RELIEF-FROM-OFFENDER-REGISTRATION and KSJC-ORDER-RELIEF-FROM-OFFENDER-REGISTRATION-COVER-SHEET — while their queueOfficialFormId carries the full identifier.
labellingHazardToCheckAtTheSameTime.whyItMatters: authorizationFor matches a scoped grant by exact documentId string. Those four truncated strings resolve license_unresolved, verified live. The disposition branch today reads officialFormId, which is the full identifier, so this is not what is excluding them now.
labellingHazardToCheckAtTheSameTime.hazard: If the corrected resolver is wired to officialDocument rather than officialFormId, exactly the four Kansas documents closest to assignable — the four whose sourceIdentityState is already exact_source_requirement_ready — would fail closed under a second, different verdict, and it would read as a second licence problem when it is a string-shape problem.
labellingHazardToCheckAtTheSameTime.instruction: Wire the resolver to the full identifier, and reconcile the four truncated officialDocument labels separately.

perRoute.whyNotReinstated: This is the one route whose entire covered document set is retained, measured and faithfully labelled, so permission and bytes are both satisfied. It is also the route where a superseded form would do the most damage. The petition was last revised February 2013 and 2025 House Bill 2393 amended K.S.A. 22-2410 afterwards — adding the (a)(2) mandatory expungement category, restating the docket fee and broadening the (b)(3)(B) fee exemption. A form predating those amendments may no longer collect what the statute now requires. Permission to reproduce a revision does not make it current, and a route reinstated onto a superseded form is worse than one left closed.

roleAndFieldConstraintsThatSurviveReinst.why: The assignment requires that no reinstated route assume authority the permission withholds. These are the places in the Kansas set where a naive implementation would assume it.

constraints.observation: The document is a court-completed order. Its first page reads 'On this ___ day of ___ 20___, the Court considers the Petition for Expungement filed herein. The State appears by ___, assistant county/district attorney or designee.' Its fields include 'The State appears by', 'IT IS THEREFORE ORDERED this', 'having reviewed the file', 'The Court' and 'upon agreement of the parties'.
constraints.automatedOwnershipHazard: The factory's field-ownership heuristic proposes ten of these fields as participant-owned and none as third-party, because it keys on the word 'petitioner'. On this document the recitals beginning 'The petitioner...' are what the court writes about the participant, not what the participant writes. Accepting the heuristic here would prefill judicial findings, which the permission expressly does not authorize.
constraints.instruction: No field on this document may be treated as participant-owned without an express finding that the governing form assigns it to the participant. The heuristic's proposal is unapproved and must not be adopted as a starting point.
Judicial findings and the judge's signature stay blank. The route may lodge it; it may not complete it.

constraints.observation: The face reads 'The court will hold hearing on this matter on ___ day of ___, 20___, at __:__ a.m./p.m. at the ___ County Courthouse, in division ___ room ___', and carries a Certificate of Service and Mailing dated by the participant after service.
constraints.consequence: The hearing date, time, division and room are court-set and are court dates within the permission's exclusions. The certificate date is a service-completion fact. Both are outside the prefill authorization even though the participant signs and serves the notice. The component can be delivered only with those blocks left for completion by hand, and the packet guidance must say so.
constraints.instruction: Do not prefill the hearing block or the certificate date. Do not treat the participant's signature line as authority to complete the court's part of the form.

constraints.automatedOwnershipHazard: The same heuristic proposes 'JUDICIAL DISTRICT' as a third-party judge field. It is the caption's judicial-district number, which is deterministic case information the participant supplies. The heuristic errs in both directions across this set and is evidence, not a map.
constraints.instruction: Field ownership for this document is established by reading the form, not by accepting the proposal.

constraints.observation: The archive filename records this asset as 'order-of-expungement-of-conviction-or-diversion' with no 'cover-sheet' in it, and its slug is truncated. Read from the filename it looks like the granting order for that route, or like the Order Denying at the same revision. It is neither: its face says COVER SHEET and its whole content is defendant identification for transmission to the Kansas Bureau of Investigation.
constraints.instruction: Bind to the cover_sheet role only. It must not satisfy KSJC-ORDER-DENYING-EXPUNGEMENT-12-2016 and it must not satisfy any order role.

roleQuestionRaisedNotDecided.question: Whether a pre-drafted Order Denying Expungement belongs in a participant's packet at all.
roleQuestionRaisedNotDecided.why: It is bound as a proposed_order on four routes. A denial order is the document a court signs when it refuses the relief the participant is asking for, and every field on it is a judicial recital. Whether the Kansas practice is that a petitioner lodges both a granting and a denying order, or whether this document is packet furniture that came in with the Council's set, is a legal-design question.
roleQuestionRaisedNotDecided.notDecidedHere: This job adjudicates reinstatement, not component composition, and it does not remap a component.
roleQuestionRaisedNotDecided.consequenceIfItIsTheWrongDocument: Two of the six routes would lose a component rather than gain a source, and the conviction-family packet would need one fewer document rather than one more binding.
